verdict.rationale: Orb ships its own event-triggered automations: user-created alerts at usage or credit-balance thresholds, real-time webhooks fired when certain events occur, and automatic top-ups when token balances run out. These are fixed, billing-specific triggers rather than a general rule engine where users define arbitrary conditions and actions. Missing for 10: a general-purpose user-defined rule/condition builder, configurable action types beyond alerts, webhooks and top-ups, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Trigger alerts at usage thresholds to power product-led growth.
